verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a web API reference at docs.sentry.io/api for programmatic management of organizations, teams and data export, so an API reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or has runnable examples, and probes for a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec at common paths all returned 404. missing for 10: interactive try-it/runnable request examples, a discoverable OpenAPI spec powering an interactive explorer, independent or hands-on corroboration of the API reference experience.
